description: This script seeds a PostgreSQL database with realistic organizational data such as roles, competencies, role adjacency, user profiles, plans, and goals. It reads JSON files for dataset input, provides a fallback minimal dataset if JSON files are missing, ensures database schema readiness, performs idempotent upsert operations, and verifies backend endpoint access.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict[str,Any]]] _load_json_list(name: str)
methods.description: Loads a list of dictionaries from a specified JSON file in the data directory; returns None if file missing or invalid.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_tables(db: Session)
methods.description: Creates minimal catalog tables in the database if they do not already exist, including roles, competencies, adjacency, and plans/goals tables.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_roles(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert or update of roles based on JSON data, matching by 'code'.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert or update of competencies based on 'code'.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts mappings between roles and competencies with required levels.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_adjacency(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts adjacency links between roles with associated weights.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_simple_users(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Updates or inserts basic user profiles with unique email key.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_plans(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts career plans based on combined 'user_id' and 'title' keys.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_goals(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upserts goals linked to plans, matched by 'plan_id' and 'description'.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Dict[str,Any]]] _fallback_dataset()
methods.description: Provides a predefined minimal dataset with roles, competencies, adjacency, mappings, demo users, plans, and goals.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _attach_goals_by_title(db: Session, goals_by_title: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Resolves plan IDs by title and upserts associated goals.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] seed_full()
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates database connection validation, schema synchronization, data seeding (JSON or fallback), and backend endpoint verification.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Entry point that runs seed_full, outputs results and error messages.
